It is also a very popular party venue, and I saw a dedicated area set up for a kid’s birthday party which looked well-managed.What really sets this Timezone apart are their incredible weekday promotions. If you want to make your budget stretch further, planning a visit during the week is a must. On Half Price Tuesdays, all video and ticket games are 50% off. On Fun Treats Wednesdays, the attractions drop to half price. Thursdays are a steal with bowling for just ₹99 and select games for ₹9, and Friday evenings offer great reload bonuses on their app.The staff is friendly, the environment is high-energy, and redeeming Powertickets at the Prize Shop at the end of the day is always a rewarding experience. They also have 3–4 good VR experiences that are definitely worth trying. The arcade games are decent, but you can skip a few of them and spend that time (and money) on the bigger experiences instead.

Overall, it’s a fun spot for a long outing with friends or family.

featured_reviews.name: Pinkesh Kamwani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Smaaash Lower Parel — Still Brings Out My Inner Child
I’ve been visiting Smaaash Lower Parel for more than a decade, and it’s one of those rare places that has managed to grow with time without losing its core charm.
Back in the day, it was all about adult-oriented fun — late nights, high energy, friends, and honestly, partying like an animal. The go-karting, especially at night, has always been a personal favourite, along with the bowling arenas, cricket box, and a wide mix of adrenaline-packed games that made it a go-to hangout spot.

Fun fact: I’ve literally celebrated every phase of life here — I even had a breakup party at Smaaash in 2014, which somehow makes my bond with this place even stronger 😄.

What I really appreciate now is how Smaaash has evolved over time. Initially, the focus was clearly more on adults, but lately they’ve done a great job of introducing kid-friendly games without taking away the excitement that adults come for.
Last night felt like a full-circle moment. I visited with my 11-year-old nephew and 7-year-old niece, and they absolutely loved it. From the games to the overall vibe, they were completely engaged and having a blast. Seeing the same place work just as well for kids today as it once did for us adults was genuinely satisfying.
Smaaash still does what it’s always done best ,it brings out your inner child, no matter your age. And now, with the younger generation hooked, I’m pretty sure I’ll be coming here regularly again.
A place full of memories, that adapts with time and still delivers fun... Smaaash Lower Parel continues to hit the mark.

featured_reviews.name: Jay Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ 1 Star

Extremely disappointing experience at Game Palacio Bandra. We booked a table for 8 people on a Saturday night by paying an advance amount through their PR, Jay, who assured us that we would get a bowling lane at 10:30 PM and specifically asked us to arrive accordingly. We reached at 10:35 PM—just 5 minutes late—and despite informing him and paying in advance, he told us that our lane had already been given away and that they could no longer assure us anything. This completely ruined our plans.

The worst part was that Jay made promises just to sell us the table and then failed to honor any of his commitments. We were willing to wait and stayed until closing time, but nobody followed up with us regarding bowling or provided any proper resolution.

There was also no prior communication that table service was restricted to bottle purchases only. After spending nearly ₹25,000, we were given a cramped table under the staircase where our heads were literally touching the stairs. Only after repeatedly requesting the manager and PR were we allowed to order beers and cocktails.

To make matters worse, a service charge of nearly ₹3,000 was added to the bill and was not removed despite multiple requests. We were incorrectly told it was mandatory, which is not in line with current government guidelines regarding service charges.

The venue also shut around 1:10 AM despite being told it would remain open until at least 1:30 AM. Overall, terrible customer service, false commitments, poor management, and a complete waste of a Saturday night. There are far better places in Bandra to spend your money. Game Palacio should be your last choice.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very disappointing experience at Game Palacio. The overall vibe of the place is great, but the service completely ruined it for us.

The staff (Sumit) was extremely rude and unprofessional. We were pressured to place our food order because the staff wanted to close the kitchen — even though it was still one hour before the official closing time. Instead of politely informing us about last order timings, the approach was pushy and disrespectful.

Very disappointed with the service experience. Would think twice before visiting again.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Dont know about the other reviews, but me personally as per my latest visit in January 2025, it was a very disappointing experience and I do not recommend at all if you want a comfortable time gaming.

Very crammed up space, the gaming chairs are broken, cheap peripherals setup. The gaming mouse is the g402 wired, cheap branded keyboard and headsets. Very dark and unhygenic atmosphere, just 1 Fan being pointed towards the reception desk where he works and 1 Air conditioning unit which is not being used to save costs unless the entire cafe is full I'm guessing.

The gaming experience on the PC is decent for now, 240hz monitors available and 3060ti GPU powered PCs.

The chairs are beyond terrible making it very uncomfortable to sit and since it's a very tiny room packed with setups there is barely any space to breathe.

If you're on an extremely tight budget and don't care about comfort, cleanliness and hygiene and just want to enjoy with your friends for the price of 60 rupees an hour, it is not bad for what you get. That's my honest review.
